scope: local segmentation runtime readiness and geometry baselines, no training or robot motion
global_original_model_policy: preserve original Base+Small weights and original baseline

local_candidate.name: YOLO26s-seg
local_candidate.role: official COCO pretrained runtime candidate; NOT an approved apple model
local_candidate.fallback_reason: RTMDet dependencies absent; user approved avoiding a compilation detour
local_candidate.input: complete field of view letterboxed to 512 or 640, no predicted crop
local_candidate.output: native visible masks and boxes copied to CPU

geometry.bounded_solver: scipy least_squares TRF with Huber loss; not classic LM
geometry.V_A_edge_agreement: weak candidate only; not verified true outer contour

synthetic_external_prior.source: illustrative protocol distribution, not measured or fitted from evaluation truth

real_data_diagnostic.source: PApple_RGB-D-Size v4, photogrammetric depth, not D405
real_data_diagnostic.teacher: historical Base original-view FP16 T15 ROI archives, NOT new inference or four-view pixel fusion
real_data_diagnostic.reported_metric: diameter error with sample denominators; never 3d-center mm error

next_data_requirement: D405 paired RGB-D with SDK native/aligned intrinsics and timestamps; does not require robot hand-eye calibration to begin camera-frame geometry experiments
control_route: gimbal scan/hold and uncalibrated visual-servo route remains a future independent integration task
